SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GE_MP_FRM_M A JOIN GE_MP_PRCDOC_M B ON A.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL = B.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL AND A.PRCDOC_RVSN_NO = B.PRCDOC_RVSN_NO
AND B.PRCDOC_NO LIKE '%'||#{PRCDOC_NO}||'%'
AND B.PRCDOC_NM LIKE '%'||#{PRCDOC_NM}||'%'
WHERE 1 = 1 AND B.DLT_YN = 'N'
AND B.PRCDOC_CFY = #{PRCDOC_CFY}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GE_MP_FRM_M ( FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL, PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL, PRCDOC_CFY, PRCDOC_RVSN_NO, ATCT_NM, ATCT_CFY, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT, DLT_YN ) VALUES ( #{FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL}, #{PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL}, #{PRCDOC_CFY}, #{PRCDOC_RVSN_NO}, #{ATCT_NM}, #{ATCT_CFY}, #{REGPR_ID}, #{REGPR_NM}, SYSDATE, 'N' )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM GE_MP_FRM_M WHERE FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL IN(${CHK_ITEMS})
mapper.select:
SELECT A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL, A.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL, A.PRCDOC_CFY, B.PRCDOC_NO, B.PRCDOC_NM, B.DOC_TYP, B.RRD_CFY, B.PPCD, A.PRCDOC_RVSN_NO, A.ATCT_NM, A.ATCT_CFY, C1.ATFL_TITL_NM AS ATFL_TITL_NM1, C2.ATFL_TITL_NM AS ATFL_TITL_NM2, C3.ATFL_TITL_NM AS ATFL_TITL_NM3, C4.ATFL_TITL_NM AS ATFL_TITL_NM4, C5.ATFL_TITL_NM AS ATFL_TITL_NM5, C1.ATFL_PHCL_NM AS ATFL_PHCL_NM1, C2.ATFL_PHCL_NM AS ATFL_PHCL_NM2, C3.ATFL_PHCL_NM AS ATFL_PHCL_NM3, C4.ATFL_PHCL_NM AS ATFL_PHCL_NM4, C5.ATFL_PHCL_NM AS ATFL_PHCL_NM5, A.REGPR_ID, A.REGPR_NM, A.RG_DT, TO_CHAR(A.RG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FM_RG_DT, (SELECT FRM_OVER_JSON FROM GE_MP_FRM1_M WHERE FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL) FRM_OVER_JSON, (SELECT FRM_CONS_JSON FROM GE_MP_FRM1_M WHERE FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL) FRM_CONS_JSON
FROM GE_MP_FRM_M A JOIN GE_MP_PRCDOC_M B ON A.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL = B.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ATFL_GRUP_NM, UNQ_NO, ATFL_ID, ATFL_TITL_NM, ATFL_GRUP_NM||'/'||ATFL_PHCL_NM||'.'||ATFL_FEXT_NM AS ATFL_PHCL_NM FROM GE_MP_FILE_S) C1 ON C1.ATFL_GRUP_NM = 'GE_MP_FRM_M' AND C1.UNQ_NO = A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL AND C1.UNQ_NO = #{FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL} AND C1.ATFL_ID = '1' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ATFL_GRUP_NM, UNQ_NO, ATFL_ID, ATFL_TITL_NM, ATFL_GRUP_NM||'/'||ATFL_PHCL_NM||'.'||ATFL_FEXT_NM AS ATFL_PHCL_NM FROM GE_MP_FILE_S) C2 ON C2.ATFL_GRUP_NM = 'GE_MP_FRM_M' AND C2.UNQ_NO = A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL AND C2.UNQ_NO = #{FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL} AND C2.ATFL_ID = '2' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ATFL_GRUP_NM, UNQ_NO, ATFL_ID, ATFL_TITL_NM, ATFL_GRUP_NM||'/'||ATFL_PHCL_NM||'.'||ATFL_FEXT_NM AS ATFL_PHCL_NM FROM GE_MP_FILE_S) C3 ON C3.ATFL_GRUP_NM = 'GE_MP_FRM_M' AND C3.UNQ_NO = A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL AND C3.UNQ_NO = #{FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL} AND C3.ATFL_ID = '3' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ATFL_GRUP_NM, UNQ_NO, ATFL_ID, ATFL_TITL_NM, ATFL_GRUP_NM||'/'||ATFL_PHCL_NM||'.'||ATFL_FEXT_NM AS ATFL_PHCL_NM FROM GE_MP_FILE_S) C4 ON C4.ATFL_GRUP_NM = 'GE_MP_FRM_M' AND C4.UNQ_NO = A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL AND C4.UNQ_NO = #{FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL} AND C4.ATFL_ID = '4' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ATFL_GRUP_NM, UNQ_NO, ATFL_ID, ATFL_TITL_NM, ATFL_GRUP_NM||'/'||ATFL_PHCL_NM||'.'||ATFL_FEXT_NM AS ATFL_PHCL_NM FROM GE_MP_FILE_S) C5 ON C5.ATFL_GRUP_NM = 'GE_MP_FRM_M' AND C5.UNQ_NO = A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL AND C5.UNQ_NO = #{FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL} AND C5.ATFL_ID = '5' WHERE A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = #{FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL}
